findings.problem: "True riches" (the correct answer on this card, from Luke 16:11) has no definition. It is a figurative phrase like "worldly wealth", "eternal dwellings" and "sons of light", which all got one. A reader who takes it as more money misses that Jesus means something greater than wealth, so the card is harder to understand. A public-domain source explains it (Barnes' Notes on Luke 16:11, the same source used for the other phrases).

rule.text: If not knowing the word would make it harder to understand what is being said, define it.
